finding: Best EfficientNet-B0 overall model is no-sampler.
decision: Use efficientnet_b0_aptos_100ep_bs16_no_sampler as the main image-only baseline.

finding: Label smoothing improved macro F1 slightly but reduced QWK.
decision: Keep label smoothing as an ablation, not the final baseline.

finding: Validation-tuned thresholds improved U-Net segmentation substantially.
evidence: IDRiD test mean Dice=0.4831, hard exudates Dice=0.6896, soft exudates Dice=0.5999.
decision: Use tuned-threshold segmentation results in README and qualitative figures.

finding: Microaneurysm segmentation remains the weakest lesion channel.
decision: Report this honestly as a limitation and future improvement target.

finding: Lesion features alone contain useful disease signal but are weaker than EfficientNet.
evidence: Best lesion-feature-only APTOS test QWK=0.7752 using logistic_regression_balanced.
decision: Use lesion features as interpretable auxiliary features, not as a replacement for image models.

finding: Probability-only meta-classifier achieved the highest APTOS test QWK.
evidence: Best APTOS test QWK=0.8965 using prob_only_logistic_balanced.
decision: Treat this as calibration/meta-classification, not lesion-based improvement.

finding: Lesion fusion improved some metrics but did not consistently dominate QWK.
evidence: Best APTOS test Macro F1=0.6716 using late_fusion_extra_trees_balanced.
decision: Report fusion results as mixed: useful for interpretability and some metric gains, but image-only EfficientNet remains very strong.

finding: Total predicted lesion area strongly correlates with DR grade.
decision: Use this as the main evidence that U-Net-derived lesion features are medically meaningful.
